On 7/27/20 1:31 PM, April Martinig wrote:
I've posted my question to Cross Validated, but I am also linking to it here because it might get missed.

I am trying to use the DHARMa package to test for how much leverage specific points (on one extreme) for my response variable has on my output. 

In my question I have posted the data, what I have tried, and linked to other sources. Thank you in advance.

Here is the link again - https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/478727/leverage-diagnostic-test-not-supported-for-glmmtmb-models-in-r.
